title: Aid
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (strip of white cloth)
text | Up to three creatures each have their current and maximum hit points increase by 5 for the duration.
text | At Higher Levels. Increase the bonus by +5 HP for every slot level above 2nd.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Alter Self
contents: text | You alter your form, choosing one of the following effects:
text | Aquatic Adaptation. Gain gills and webbing. You can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
text | Change Appearance. Alter height, voice, race, or features. You can reshape your appearance again using an Action. No change to size or stats.
text | Natural Weapons. Grow claws, fangs, etc. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + STR magical damage and have +1 to hit/damage.
text | These changes don’t survive physical inspection (Investigation vs your spell save DC).
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Arcane Lock
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (25 gp gold dust)
text | You ward a door, window, chest, gate, or similar object against entry. Until the spell is dispelled, the object is magically locked.
text | Opening the object requires either casting a Knock spell on it, or succeeding on a Strength or Dexterity check (using thieves' tools) with the DC increased by +10.
text | You may set a password when you cast the spell. Speaking the password suppresses the lock for 1 minute.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Arcane Vigor
contents: text | You surround yourself with shimmering motes of arcane force.
text | Gain a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.
text | Once per turn, when you take damage, you can use your Reaction to halve the damage.
text | This effect does not reduce effects that aren't damage (e.g., conditions or saves).
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Blur
contents: text | Your form shimmers and distorts, making it hard to pinpoint your true location.
text | For the duration, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage.
text | The effect ends early if you're incapacitated or if you can’t move.
text | Creatures that don't rely on sight, or can see through illusions, are unaffected.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Continual Flame
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (ruby dust worth 50 gp)
text | You touch an object to create a permanent, heatless flame that shines with magical light.
text | The flame sheds bright light in a 20-ft radius and dim light for an additional 20 ft.
text | You choose the flame’s color. It can’t be extinguished by mundane means.
text | The flame can be covered to block the light, but not smothered or quenched.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Darkvision
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate)
text | You touch a willing creature, granting it the ability to see in the dark.
text | For the duration, the target gains darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.
text | This allows it to see in darkness as if it were dim light, but only in shades of gray.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Dragon's Breath
contents: text | The touched creature can use an Action to exhale a 15-ft cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison (your choice).
text | Targets in the cone make a Dex save; on fail they take 3d6 damage of the chosen type (half on success).
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Enhance Ability (1/2)
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (fur or feather from a beast)
text | Choose a creature and one ability:
bullet | Bear’s Endurance — Adv. on Con checks & 2d6 temp HP.
bullet | Bull’s Strength — Adv. on Str checks; carry weight doubled.
bullet | Cat’s Grace — Adv. on Dex checks; no fall damage ≤ 20 ft.
bullet | Eagle’s Splendor — Adv. on Cha checks.
bullet | Fox’s Cunning — Adv. on Int checks.
bullet | Owl’s Wisdom — Adv. on Wis checks.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Enlarge / Reduce
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (pinch of powdered iron)
text | You alter a creature’s size and power for the duration.
text | Choose a creature within range. It must succeed on a Constitution save or be affected. You decide if it is enlarged or reduced.
bullet | Size increases by one category.
bullet | Advantage on Strength checks and saves.
bullet | Size decreases by one category.
bullet | Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves.
bullet | 1d4 damage with Strength-based weapons min1
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Heat Metal
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (piece of iron & flame)
text | Choose a manufactured metal object; it glows red-hot, dealing 2d8 fire damage to anyone in contact.
text | A creature holding/wearing it must succeed on Con save or drop it (if possible) and has Disadv. on attack rolls/ability checks until next turn.
text | On subsequent turns, you can use a Bonus Action to repeat the damage automatically.
text | At Higher Levels. Damage + 1d8 per slot above 2nd.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Homunculus Servant
contents: text | You infuse the gem to create a Homunculus companion that obeys your commands in combat.
text | The creature uses the stat-block in UA (HP = Int mod + Artificer level × 2).
text | In combat it shares your initiative; it can move and take reactions on its own, but it only attacks when you command (Bonus Action).
text | If it drops to 0 HP it turns inert, but can be recreated with the spell again.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Invisibility
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (pinch of eyelash & gum arabic)
text | You touch a creature (and their worn or carried gear), rendering them invisible for the duration.
text | The spell ends early if the target attacks or casts a spell.
text | While invisible, the creature is heavily obscured and cannot be seen without magical means such as See Invisibility or True Sight.
text | At Higher Levels. When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature per slot level above 2nd.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Lesser Restoration
contents: text | You touch a creature and end one condition afflicting it.
text | The condition must be: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Levitate
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (bit of leather looped with golden wire)
text | One creature/object rises vertically up to 20 ft and remains suspended.
text | You can move the target by 20 ft up or down on subsequent turns (Action).
text | An unwilling target may make a Con save; on success the spell is negated.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Magic Mouth
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (honeycomb + jade chip worth 10 gp)
text | You enchant an object to deliver a 25-word message when a trigger you define occurs (sight, sound, or proximity ≤ 30 ft).
text | The mouth appears on the object and recites the message in your voice.
text | The trigger can be simple or complex (e.g., "when a goblin speaks" or "when someone opens this door").
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Magic Weapon
contents: text | The touched non-magical weapon becomes +1 magic for the duration.
text | At Higher Levels. Cast with a 4th-level slot for +2, or 6th-level slot for +3.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Protection from Poison
contents: text | You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize one poison currently affecting it.
text | For the duration, the target has Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and gains Resistance to poison damage.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Rope Trick
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (powdered corn + twisted loop of parchment)
text | The rope rises vertically to an extra-dimensional space at top (entrance 3 × 5 ft).
text | Up to 8 Medium or smaller creatures can climb inside (no sound/light passes).
text | When the spell ends, occupants fall out.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: See Invisibility
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (pinch of talc + silver powder)
text | For the duration, you can see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible.
text | You can also see into the Ethereal Plane, up to 60 ft.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Spider Climb
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (drop of bitumen + spider leg)
text | The target gains a climb speed equal to its walking speed for the duration.
text | It can move up vertical surfaces and across ceilings while leaving its hands free.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Web
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (bit of spider web)
text | Thick web fills 20-ft cube. Area counts as difficult terrain and lightly obscured.
text | Creatures entering or starting turn there must succeed Dex save or be Restrained (escape check Str / Dex).
text | Webs are flammable; fire deals 2d4 dmg to creatures in area.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5

title: Homunculus servant
contents: bullet | Languages: Telepathy (1 mile, only with creator)
bullet | Evasion. On a DEX save for half damage, takes none on success, half on fail.
bullet | Magic Bond. Add spell level to any ability check or saving throw it makes.
text | Force Strike. Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + spell level force damage.
text | Channel Magic. If you cast a touch-range spell and the homunculus is within 120 ft, it can deliver the spell through its touch.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 2 | Artificer Level 5
